claim: Patchline ships a regression-discontinuity study around adoption thresholds with a placebo test. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the regression-discontinuity claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make regression-discontinuity-study-gate`.
